entities.name: Kotis
entities.description: A sibsig warrior from Kishla Village, Fangkeeper (khan) of the Sultai Brood, bound to the spirit dragon Teval.

entities.name: Kishla Village
entities.description: Village on Tarkir where Kotis was a farmer.

entities.name: Sultai Brood
entities.description: A clan led by the Fangkeeper.

entities.name: Teval
entities.description: A spirit dragon called into being by Kotis.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: Dragonlord whose minions stole the village's crops; ruled over the village.

entities.name: Sidisi
entities.description: Ruler defeated in the rebellion, partly through Kotis.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Kotis fought and was killed.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: Ritual during which Kotis called Teval into being.

events.summary: Kotis organizes his village's resistance against Silumgar, earning brief independence; rebels flee to the jungle after a counterattack.
events.quote: he organized his village's resistance, earning it brief independence from Silumgar's rule

events.summary: Kotis fights in the New Phyrexian Invasion and is killed, then revived in a necromantic ritual as a sibsig.
events.quote: so he was brought back to life in a necromantic ritual

events.summary: Kotis is partly responsible for Sidisi's defeat.
events.quote: Kotis was partially responsible for Sidisi 's defeat

events.summary: During the Stormnexus Ritual Kotis calls the spirit dragon Teval into being.
events.quote: Kotis called the spirit dragon Teval into being

events.summary: After the dragonlords fall, Kotis is installed as Fangkeeper.
events.quote: Kotis was installed as the Fangkeeper

relations.quote: He is the current Fangkeeper ( khan ) of the Sultai Brood

relations.note: Called the spirit dragon into being.
relations.quote: Kotis called the spirit dragon Teval into being
